answer_text:
Great news! Here's a comprehensive guide on where to buy the latest iPhone:

### 📱 The Latest iPhones (2025–2026)
Apple's current flagship iPhone lineup includes the **iPhone 17e** (2026), **iPhone 17**, **iPhone 17 Pro**, **iPhone 17 Pro Max**, and **iPhone Air** (all 2025).

---

### 🛒 Where to Buy

1. **Apple (apple.com or Apple Store)**
The best place to start! Apple offers two‑hour delivery from an Apple Store, free next‑day delivery, or convenient Apple pickup options. When you buy directly from Apple, you'll get access to Personal Setup — guided online sessions where a Specialist can walk you through setup and data transfer. You can also trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase.
🔗 [apple.com/iphone](https://www.apple.com/iphone/)

2. **Best Buy**
Best Buy carries the latest Apple iPhones and accessories. You can look for trade-in discounts as well as offers made by coverage plans, and you might consider an unlocked iPhone to gain cellular plan coverage flexibility or open-box products for discounted prices.
🔗 [bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/mobile-cell-phones/iphone/pcmcat305200050000.c)

3. **T-Mobile**
T-Mobile carries the iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17e, iPhone Air, and iPhone 17, often with carrier deals and financing options.
🔗 [t-mobile.com](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phones/brand/apple)

4. **Other Carriers** (AT&T, Verizon, etc.)
Major carriers typically carry the full iPhone lineup and often offer promotional deals, trade-in credits, and installment plans.

---

### 💡 Quick Price Guide
- The **iPhone 17e** is Apple's most affordable option at **$599**, featuring the A19 chip, 256GB base storage, MagSafe charging, and a 48MP Fusion camera.
- The **iPhone 17** starts at **$799** and includes a 120Hz ProMotion display.
- The **iPhone 17 Pro** starts at **$999** and shares the same A19 Pro chip and camera system as the Pro Max in a 6.3-inch form factor — the model most tech reviewers are recommending in 2026.
- The **iPhone 17 Pro Max** is the top-of-the-line model with the A19 Pro chip and a 6.9-inch ProMotion OLED display.

---

### 💸 Tips for Saving Money
- If your budget doesn't stretch to the newest models, buying an older, preferably refurbished iPhone from a reputable source can last you years and is a great way to save money.
- If you're on an iPhone 16 or newer, it may be worth waiting to see what September 2026 brings before committing, as new iPhone 18 models are expected then.
